get.description: Auto-suggest tags for an existing event from the fixed taxonomy.

put.description:
Store a PER-STUDENT tag override for an event (empty set allowed).

LIMITATION (prototype): this is scoped to the calling demo user, stored in
that user's PreferenceState. It is NOT a shared, organizer-wide correction
visible to other students -- the app has no separate organizer identity yet.
The override takes priority over the auto-assigned tags for THIS user only.

Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: Small private JSON attachment. No device paths or arbitrary remote URLs.

TagCorrection.title: TagCorrection
TagCorrection.description:
A PER-STUDENT final tag set for an event. Overrides the auto tags for that
user only (the prototype has no shared organizer identity). An empty list is a
meaningful override ("no tag applies"), not 'uncorrected'.
